modos.descricao: Splinter the Weakened Mind (REVISAO MANUAL NECESSARIA)

params.texto_original: Play on a character who has just declared an attack. That character is now attacking an eligible target of your choice.

_metadata.texto_original: Play on a character who has just declared an attack. That character is now attacking an eligible target of your choice. The Gift user's Gnosis must exceed his target's. A character cannot be made to attack an opponent he could not legitimately attack. Dis
